title: Use of wearables for pre- and postoperative monitoring of patients after radical robot-assisted or open cystectomy
summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the use of wearables for continuous pre- and postoperative monitoring of vital signs in patients undergoing radical cystectomy. Patients participating in the study will receive a wearable, e.g. a fitness watch (e.g. Fitbit, Xiaomi or similar) or a fitness ring (e.g. Samsung, Oura or similar).  In addition to giving their consent, all patients fill out a questionnaire before the operation that analyses their willingness to use wearables and their acceptance of digital biomarkers.

interventions.name: Adult patients with planned radical robotic-assisted or open cystectomy receive a wearable for continuous recording of physiological parameters (heart rate, activity, sleep, temperature) for up to 8 weeks (pre- and postoperative). The data is stored pseudonymised and evaluated with regard to feasibi

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. planned open or robot-assisted cystectomy 
2. age of the patient ≥18 years and capacity to consent
3. mobile patient who is not dependent on a walking aid
4. patient gives consent by signing and dating the consent form before the surgical procedure.
Exclusion criteria:
1. emergency cystectomy
2. skin diseases that prevent the wearing of wearables
3. lack of compliance
